name: count_sheet_line
description: REQ-701 / GH #3736. One line of the count sheet of a count order: a ledger balance key as of the cut-off (kind stock, book_quantity from the stock ledger) or a surplus line the commission added (kind surplus, book_quantity 0). count_order_id is a real foreign key onto count_order; org_unit_id is a copy of the header's, the scope column (decision 0076 R7). counted_quantity is empty until the commission has counted the line. Quantities are exact decimals (precision 24, scale 9, decimal_strict). Master references are record ids checked in code (0076 R6).
